infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeTour needs foreground location to display nearby safety zones, geofence corridors, and local assistance outposts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SafeTour uses continuous corridor telemetry during registered trips to detect severe route divergences and deliver automatic risk-zone warnings.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: SafeTour detects abrupt falls or sudden changes in elevation along mountain trails.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SafeTour to monitor your safety corridor while traveling in remote zones.
